entries.what: Grace decided to move her walks to dawn so evenings stay free for her mother, and started with a 5:45 a.m. Ulloa Salt Marsh boardwalk walk with Dana, even though it was a Monday.
entries.outcome: Sets the Tuesday and Thursday dawn walk routine from here on; evening Delgado Park loops end.

entries.what: Taught periods 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 in B12, with atomic structure review in Unit 2, and ate leftover rice and ulam during 4th period prep. Dana joined for lunch on her usual Monday.
entries.outcome: Normal day; Dana vented about her evaluations.

entries.what: Home by evening, Grace made dinner and sat with Corazón for the 9 p.m. teleserye.
entries.outcome: Quiet evening free for her mother.

entries.what: Tuesday dawn walk on the marsh boardwalk with Dana, then the Tuesday lunch lab-makeup session in B12.
entries.outcome: Second dawn walk done; the new routine holds.

entries.what: Isabel came home from her early-action meeting with counselor Eugene Kim, and Grace sat down afterward to look up net price calculators and run the family's numbers.
entries.outcome: Grace was surprised by the aid estimates and decided to keep gathering tax documents.

entries.what: That night she asked the assistant to explain how net price calculators work and what the aid numbers mean.
entries.outcome: Got a clear explanation and a list of schools to test.

entries.what: Taught all five sections and used prep to run Eli's extended-time test in B12.
entries.outcome: Test done without interruption.

entries.what: Grace went to the city council candidate forum at the Vinca Avenue Community Center and listened to the Measure K debate.
entries.outcome: Decided she will vote yes on Measure K.

entries.what: Picked up Corazón's prescriptions at the Vinca Avenue drugstore after school before the forum.
entries.outcome: Pills restocked.

entries.what: Thursday 5:45 a.m. boardwalk walk with Dana, then she taught periods 1 to 3 including Dulce's third period.
entries.outcome: Walk routine established twice a week.

entries.what: Ate lunch in B12 with Dana, then 4th period prep went to grading Unit 2 labs.
entries.outcome: Stack of grading cut in half.

entries.what: The minivan sputtered on the way home and Grace checked used car listings that night.
entries.outcome: Booked a Saturday lot visit.

entries.what: Taught five sections and filled out the weekly absence form with her spreadsheet template, submitting by 3:30.
entries.outcome: Friday form turned in on time.

entries.what: Ate dinner with the family; Isabel and Grace bickered briefly about weekend plans while Ramón was on shift.
entries.outcome: Dropped it before it escalated.

entries.what: Lesson prep for Unit 2 wrap-up and an early night.
entries.outcome: In bed by 10.

entries.what: Saturday groceries at Ruiz Family Market and rolls from Panadería Las Hermanas, then to a Tamsen lot to buy the 2019 blue hatchback, $14,200 financed.
entries.outcome: Bought the hatchback; payments of $318 a month start Nov 15, replacing the dying minivan.

entries.what: Filled the new car at the Ruel Road station and drove home.
entries.outcome: Saved the 30 cents a gallon.

entries.what: Told Corazón and Isabel about the new car over dinner.
entries.outcome: Isabel teased about the color.

entries.what: Tagalog Mass at 9 with Corazón at Our Lady of the Marsh, then lunch.
entries.outcome: Usual Sunday.

entries.what: Graded at the kitchen table all afternoon while Corazón cooked sinigang.
entries.outcome: Grading finished by dinner.

entries.what: Evening with the assistant: had a parent email cut to under 120 words with the pleasantry removed, then asked for a script to ask Lola Cora about her meter readings without sounding like she was checking up.
entries.outcome: Got a short email and a gentle script she plans to use before Ramón gets home.
